name: gradient-space-shift
title: Space Shift
description: A static diagonal gradient: deep indigo in the lower-left corner travelling through mid blue and turquoise to a fresh mint green in the upper right, presented as a wide rounded block.
use: A cool diagonal wash should sit behind a product or data page without competing with it.
avoid: The four stops are fixed in code; changing the palette or direction needs a source edit.
a11y: Decorative surface with no controls, so accessibility actions do not apply. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A wide rounded rectangle on a near-black stage, painted along a diagonal axis. It starts as dark indigo at the lower left, crosses royal blue and a bright turquoise, and finishes in pale mint green at the upper right.
behaves: Static: nothing moves or responds, and the same diagonal blend is shown throughout.
customise: className and style adjust size and can override the paint; the four gradient stops are written in the file.
weight: light: A single div with one CSS gradient; no animation or script.
